items.title: AI 투자 공포…美 반도체주 7곳서 하루 새 860조 증발 [뉴욕증시 브리핑]
items.content:
AI 투자 공포…美 반도체주 7곳서 하루 새 860조 증발 [뉴욕증시 브리핑]

뉴욕증시가 인공지능(AI) 투자비 부담에 대한 우려가 커지면서 일제히 급락했다. 빅테크가 AI 인프라에 쏟아붓는 막대한 자금이 실제 수익으로 돌아오는 데 시간이 걸릴 것이라는 불안이 반도체주를 중심으로 확산했다.

30일(현지시간) 뉴욕증권거래소(NYSE)에서 다우존스30산업평균지수는 전 거래일보다 572.25포인트(1.1%) 내린 51,770.31에 거래를 마쳤다. 스탠더드앤드푸어스(S&P)500지수는 140.32포인트(1.8%) 떨어진 7580.07을 기록했다. 기술주 중심의 나스닥지수는 747.73포인트(2.9%) 급락한 25,437에 마감했다. S&P500지수는 지난 6월 이후 가장 큰 하루 낙폭을 기록했다.

반도체주에서 사라진 시가총액도 천문학적이었다. 엔비디아·인텔·AMD·브로드컴·마이크론·퀄컴·Arm 등 미국 반도체주 7곳의 시가총액은 이날 하루 약 6470억달러(867조원) 감소했다. AI 투자 열풍의 최대 수혜주들이 그동안 시장을 끌어올렸던 만큼 투자심리가 돌아서자 충격도 이들 종목에 집중됐다.

이날 급락의 진원지는 인텔이었다. 인텔은 시장 예상에 미치지 못한 4분기 실적 전망을 내놓으면서 28.6% 폭락했다. 1974년 이후 가장 큰 하루 낙폭이다. 데이터센터·AI 부문 매출이 증가했지만 PC 시장 부진과 생산능력 제약, 투자비 부담이 더 크게 부각됐다.

인텔의 충격은 반도체주 전반으로 번졌다. 엔비디아는 4.2%, AMD는 10.9% 하락했고 필라델피아반도체지수는 7.2% 급락했다. AI 데이터센터 투자 확대에 대한 기대감으로 주가가 가파르게 올랐던 종목을 중심으로 차익 실현 매물이 쏟아졌다.

아마존의 실적도 AI 투자비를 둘러싼 불안을 키웠다. 아마존은 최근 12개월 동안 424억달러의 현금이 순유출된 것으로 나타났다. AI와 데이터센터 투자를 중심으로 설비투자 규모가 시장 예상보다 약 200억달러 많았던 점이 투자심리를 압박했다. 아마존 주가는 2%가량 하락했다.

앞서 구글 모회사 알파벳도 검색 광고 실적 부진과 마이너스 잉여현금흐름을 공개한 뒤 주가가 12% 넘게 급락했다. 빅테크의 공격적인 AI 투자가 매출 성장으로 이어지고 있지만 투자한 돈을 언제 회수할 수 있을지는 여전히 불투명하다는 인식이 확산한 것이다.

시장의 평가 기준도 달라지고 있다. 이전까지는 AI 투자 확대 자체가 성장 신호로 받아들여졌지만 이제는 투자가 실제 이익과 현금흐름으로 연결되는 시점을 증명해야 주가를 방어할 수 있다는 압박이 커졌다.

안전자산 선호가 강해지면서 미국 국채금리는 하락했다. 반면 중동 정세 불안으로 국제유가는 상승해 증시에 추가 부담으로 작용했다. 고유가가 인플레이션을 다시 자극하면 미국 중앙은행(Fed)의 긴축 기조가 예상보다 길어질 수 있다는 우려도 이어졌다.

주간 기준으로 S&P500지수는 0.6%, 다우지수는 0.9%, 나스닥지수는 2.0% 각각 하락했다. 중소형주 중심의 러셀2000지수는 같은 기간 1.3% 상승했다.

증권과 금융 분야를 거쳐 현재 부동산 시장과 주택 정책을 취재하고 있습니다. 재건축·재개발, 청약, 주택 공급, 세금, 대출 규제, 부동산 금융이 실수요자와 투자자에게 미치는 영향을 현장과 데이터를 바탕으로 분석합니다.

국토교통부, 한국부동산원, 금융권 등 공신력 있는 자료를 교차 확인하고 건설사·학계·연구기관·공인중개사 등 다양한 현장의 목소리를 함께 취재합니다.

'철길옆집', '이송렬의 우주인' 등의 연재를 통해 복잡한 정책과 시장 변화를 독자가 이해하기 쉽게 전달하고 있습니다. 모든 기사는 사실 확인과 출처 검증을 최우선 원칙으로 작성합니다.

items.summary: Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.
items.summary_ko: 바이낸스의 약 63억 달러 규모로 추정되는 해킹에서 공격자들은 Tether, Circle 등이 동결할 수 있는 스테이블코인을 동결이 어려운 BTC, ETH로 빠르게 전환했다. 이 해킹은 지난달 Bitget 해킹과 같은 북한 연계 해커 집단의 소행으로 알려졌다. Binance는 금요일 약 30억 달러가 온체인에서 동결되었다고 밝혔다.
items.content:
Attackers raced to convert stolen stablecoins into crypto that issuers could not freeze as industry players like Tether and Circle moved to immobilize billions of dollars in assets.

Attackers behind Binance’s estimated $6.3 billion hack still control billions of dollars in stolen cryptocurrency despite efforts by token issuers to freeze the proceeds.

The attack, the largest in crypto history, began at 8:04 pm UTC Thursday and the perpetrators, linked to the same North Korean hackers behind last month’s Bitget hack, immediately began converting assets.

The game plan for the hackers was to convert the assets that could be frozen, like USDT and USDC, into ones that could not, such as Bitcoin (BTC) and Ether (ETH).

CertiK engineer Dickson Wu traced $500 million in USDT that was sent to one address, with $325 million sold to market makers for ETH by 20:59 UTC, less than an hour after the hack began.

They were racing against some of crypto’s most powerful gatekeepers: stablecoin giants like Tether and Circle, who had already begun blacklisting addresses associated with the theft .

Binance said Friday that about $3 billion of the stolen assets were frozen onchain out of an estimated $6.3 billion total, and that it is working with law enforcement , issuers and blockchain analytics firms to trace additional funds.

The scale of the theft is mind-boggling, even in crypto terms, but with around half of the assets already frozen, how much of the stolen crypto can the perpetrators actually spend?

Unlike BTC or ETH, which are decentralized cryptocurrencies with no central issuer and no one to hit the pause button, centralized stablecoins like Tether’s USDT and Circle’s USDC have issuers that can freeze tokens held at specific addresses.

Binance said it is working with law enforcement to trace the funds. Source: Binance

That gives them the power to act swiftly in incidents like these. Tether froze around $1.567 billion in USDT in total, with the first major freeze happening just 37 minutes after the stolen funds reached the attacker’s main Ethereum wallet.

Related: Binance says it holds $5B in matching tokens to cover hack losses

Circle froze around $823 million in USDC three minutes later, with other issuers like Ripple and World Liberty Financial following soon after.

The ability to immobilize crypto is not exclusively a stablecoin feature, and despite not having central issuers, some decentralized protocols like Arbitrum did not sit idly by.

Arbitrum’s Security Council moved around $30.5 million in ARB and ETH into an intermediary frozen wallet, where they can only be moved after further action by the council or a vote by Arbitrum DAO governance.

One important distinction remains — frozen funds don’t necessarily equate to recovered funds. Immobilizing assets prevents the suspected attackers from spending them, but it doesn’t automatically return them to Binance or its users.

Decentralized lending protocol Aave adds another layer of complexity to the equation. Between 20:58 and 21:01 UTC, a wallet associated with the attackers deposited $60 million in USDT into Aave V3 on Ethereum and borrowed $44.6 million of wrapped Ether (WETH), around 40 minutes before the first freeze.

LlamaRisk, an Aave risk service provider, said in its 1:00 am update that the attacker’s position subsequently held around $59.9 million in USDT collateral against $43.8 million in debt. Aave said the position remained overcollateralized and did not put protocol suppliers at risk.

Largest crypto heists of all time. Source: Elliptic

Since the USDT had already been deposited into Aave’s lending pool, blacklisting the attacker’s wallet could not automatically retrieve the collateral held by the protocol, as Aave Chan Initiative founder Marc Zeller explained :

To prevent further deposits and borrowing, Aave temporarily froze markets across its V3 and V4 deployments, although existing users could still withdraw funds, repay loans and liquidate…

items.content:
dbreunig/nesformer ( via ) Inspired by qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal, Drew Breunig baked a working emulator for a Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B. You can now play NES ROMs such as Super Mario Bros (very slowly) running inside Qwen!

In a comment on Hacker News Drew reveals the Opus 5.5 prompts he used to build this system:

Read this article and any relevant source code: https://divagr.com/blog/qwenputer. Then explore if you could emulate the chip and ram in a Nintendo Entertainment System (as people do today with FPGAs in MISTRs) using this technique. If so, what size model would you have to build and if you could use smaller faster ones, could you get it to be at the standard clockspeed.

I think we should build it! Just for fun. It's okay if it's not fast. We want to be able to have the weights, and a cli to run them that we can point at a ROM.

Apparently Opus found and then used this collection of conformance tests for the NES CPU released 15 years ago by Christopher Pow.

This is a link post by Simon Willison, posted on 30th October 2026 .

items.content_ko: Drew Breunig는 Hacker News 댓글에서 이 시스템 구축에 사용한 Opus 5.5 프롬프트 내용을 밝혔다. 프롬프트는 qwenputer 글과 관련 소스 코드를 읽은 뒤, 같은 기법으로 FPGA(MiSTer)처럼 NES의 CPU와 RAM을 에뮬레이션할 수 있는지 검토하고 필요한 모델 크기와 표준 클럭 속도 달성 가능성을 묻는다. Breunig는 가중치와 ROM을 지정해 실행하는 CLI를 원하며, 속도가 느려도 괜찮다고 적었다. Opus는 15년 전 Christopher Pow가 공개한 NES CPU 적합성 테스트 모음을 찾아 사용했다고 한다. 이 글은 Simon Willison이 2026년 10월 30일에 올린 링크 포스트다.

Intel’s stock suffered one of its worst days ever on Friday, crashing around 28% after the chip giant reported a weaker-than-expected outlook for the fourth quarter.

This rout reduced the value of Intel’s holdings by the government by $12 billion, CNBC reports . The Trump administration had the government buy 10% stake over a year ago. Nvidia, which also took a big stake in Intel in 2025, saw its stock drop a bit on Friday as well. Much of the tech industry — especially chipmakers — were caught in the sell-off.

Intel’s stock is still a profitable investment for the government so far (and for Nvidia), as it’s up more than 70% for the year, even if it’s dropped significantly from the sky-high prices it commanded over the summer.

The scare-off was caused when Intel warned to expect revenue of $15 billion to $16 billion in the fourth quarter when analysts were looking for around $17 billion. It also warned that its gross profit margin would decline to 37% from 43%, and it was investing so heavily, it expected no positive cash flow.

The main problem for Intel is that PC sales are being hurt by the AI industry gobbling memory and other components, and causing PC prices to rise .

“Our customers began signaling a PC slowdown based on the memory prices and availability. Year-to-date system endpoint prices have increased significantly, placing additional pressure on already limited IT budgets,” Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan warned on the call.

The bright side is that revenue from Intel’s data center business grew 78% over the year-ago quarter. But it is hamstrung on that front until it can bring more capacity to its fabs and book more external customers for them, competing with powerhouse Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co . One of Intel’s new fabs in Arizona is operational but the next one isn’t expected to be online until 2028.

Anthropic is expected to receive a high “junk” rating from credit rating agencies following its initial public offering, according to a report from the Financial Times.

The FT says the investment giant Blackstone, the anchor investor in a recent $63 billion deal to finance Anthropic’s chips, told investors in the deal that it expects the AI lab to receive a “high” junk rating after its IPO. Previously, the FT notes, Blackstone had said the opposite: that the Claude maker would receive an investment-grade rating (indicating low risk for lenders) before 2027 rolls around.

Now Blackstone expects double B range rating, the top tier of speculative “junk” grade, according to the reporting.

TechCrunch reached out to Anthropic and Blackstone but both declined to comment.

Blackstone’s forecast is just a prediction, but naturally, a high junk rating would make it more difficult and costlier for Anthropic to raise the money to keep funding its massive spending that has undergirded its business. The lab has been on a spending spree, racking up large compute power deals throughout the past 12 months, which has worried investors .

Anthropic officially filed to go public earlier this week, kicking off a wave of speculation about how the massive IPO would impact the broader AI industry .

It happens to the best of us — you’ve completely dropped the ball on figuring out a Halloween costume. Naturally, you’ve decided to solve this problem by turning to… TechCrunch? Yeah, sure, why not. I’ve got some ideas.

Here are some last-minute techy Halloween costumes. Effort levels vary.

AI leaders like Dario Amodei and Sam Altman have expressed their fears that AI is developing too quickly , but if AI models become capable of “recursive self-improvement,” they’ll be able to advance on their own without human intervention, rendering any efforts to “pace the frontier” futile.

I’m not sure how to visually represent the idea of an AI building itself, but you could really lean into the “self-improvement” part and forget the “recursive” aspect — it’s a last-minute Halloween costume. You don’t need to try that hard.

Dress as the version of yourself you imagine becoming every year when you make New Year’s resolutions. Carry around a self-help or productivity book like “Atomic Habits” or anything by Malcolm Gladwell, a yoga mat, and a huge bottle of water. Leave in the middle of the party to “go to therapy” when you actually just want to go home. Brag to people about how good your Oura Ring’s sleep score is.

You are the embodiment of someone trying to better themselves. You are recursive self-improvement.

Meta and OpenAI both recently launched AI assistants with creepily cute avatars. It’s almost Elizabeth Holmes-esque — they look innocent, so you underestimate their potential to cause disaster. (While we’re talking about her, you’re only allowed to do the black turtleneck Holmes costume if you’re a natural blonde, or if you have a blonde wig.)

What you’re going to do is make yourself look big and fluffy. Maybe you have a poofy puffer jacket, or maybe you can find some colorful feather boas to wrap yourself in. Add a distinctive hat, glasses, or other accessory to make yourself look more like a ChatGPT dot. If you have a colorful shirt and matching bottoms, that also works.

Throughout the night, ask people if you can obtain read/write access to their Gmail.

Whether you call them “pervert glasses” or not, we should all be able to agree that it would be really spooky if someone just started recording you without your consent — perfectly in keeping with the Halloween spirit.

Just grab a pair of glasses — or buy a cheap pair somewhere convenient — and attach a big red or white circle to one lens, mimicking the red recording light. If you want to make the costume extra creepy (or, if you can’t make a big circle sticker), you can just wear normal glasses and say that you’re “guy recording with the light covered up.” Please, just don’t actually record people without their consent while you wear this costume.

While we’re at it, Mark Zuckerberg’s fashion has been pretty recognizable lately. He’s been wearing a lot of slightly oversized, boxy black T-shirts.

It may be hard to replicate the black-text-on-black-shirt style he gravitates toward, but you could attach a piece of paper to yourself that says “Building is my love language.”

If you feel confident in your Latin pronunciation, you could go for something actually scary, like the time he wore a shirt that said “Aut Zuck aut nihil,” which means “Either Zuck or nothing.” It’s a little ominous.

For some people, there’s nothing scarier than running out of Claude tokens.

Grab a piece of cardboard, print out screenshots of notifications telling you that you’ve reached your usage limit, and go spook some vibe-coders. I’ve illustrated this idea using an edited stock photo. You don’t have to dress like you work at Hot Topic — that’s just the model in the image.

Investors are getting nervous about AI infrastructure spending just as the Big Tech companies double down.

Over the past two weeks, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft have outlined plans to spend more than $740 billion on capital expenditures this year, which Wall Street is reading as AI infrastructure spending, including data centers and chips.

Earlier in the AI boom, investors largely rewarded such big outlays, viewing them as a sign of confidence in the technology’s growth potential. But as we enter the fourth quarter, that enthusiasm seems to be giving way to concerns about negative free cash flow (spending more cash than a company brings in), mounting debt, and whether these enormous investments will ever generate enough returns.

The anxiety spilled across the market on Friday. The Nasdaq fell 2.9%, and chip stocks took a drubbing, too: Nvidia dropped 4%, Broadcom more than 5%, and Qualcomm 11%. Alphabet, which plummeted 12% on Thursday, its worst day on record, wiping out $500 billion in market value, fell again.

A big part of the concern is that companies that used to have overflowing free cash flow from their core businesses are getting hit as AI threatens the economics of those businesses. Alphabet provided the clearest example of that this week. Google’s parent company reported negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion in the third quarter, its second consecutive quarter in the red, even as quarterly capex grew to $51.4 billion. Alphabet expects to spend up to $205 billion this year, and expects that spending to keep rising in 2027.

Meanwhile, the wild success of AI Mode — Google’s AI-powered chatbot feature built directly into Search — is eating into the company’s money-maker. Google’s Search advertising business, which makes up roughly half of its revenue, saw growth slow to 12%, its weakest pace in five quarters. That leaves Google walking a tightrope. It’s spending billions on the AI technology that could undermine the search business that pays it.

Amazon is in a similar boat after reporting negative free cash flow of $42.4 billion over the past 12 months, compared with $14.8 billion in positive free cash flow the year before. The company says it expects to spend $220 billion in capex this year. Even though revenue at its cloud business, AWS, grew 39%, Amazon’s stock tumbled 7% after it reported earnings Thursday.

Meta is also burning cash, reporting negative free cash flow of $2.1 billion in the third quarter as capex outpaced its operating cash. It’s guiding to as much as $145 billion in capex this year. The company noted that Muse, its new free personal AI agent, is a bit of a money pit (it’s “very compute-intensive to run,” CEO Mark Zuckerberg has said). But ad revenue grew 26%. Still, no amount of good news saved Meta from taking a 10% hit on its stock last week.

Microsoft was the only exception when it came to free cash flow — it recorded $18.6 billion in positive free cash flow in its latest quarter, with spending on capex at $45.2 billion, less than the $50 billion it projected. Microsoft said that wasn’t an intentional pullback from AI spending, blaming delays in capacity from third-party providers. As a result, shares of smaller companies that rent out AI computing power sank .

It’s worth noting that the money to pay for all of this AI infrastructure isn’t just coming from the Big Tech companies’ profits. It’s also showing up in stock and bond sales. According to S&P Global Market Intelligence, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Oracle raised a combined $326 billion in debt in 2026, triple the amount raised last year.

Demand for AI compute remains strong. Google, Amazon, and Microsoft all saw gains in their cloud businesses. But investors are getting spooked by the costs of meeting that demand.

items.content:
Critical Linux kernel flaw allows remote root attacks on MPTCP servers

Security researchers at Anthropic have developed an exploit for a critical Linux kernel vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute commands as root on servers running Multipath TCP (MPTCP) listeners.

The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-98432 , also affects ordinary TCP connections, although remote code execution has not been publicly demonstrated on servers without an MPTCP listener.

Multipath TCP (MPTCP) is a TCP feature that lets a single connection use multiple network paths at the same time to improve performance and reliability. It is commonly used in environments where devices have multiple network connections, such as Wi-Fi and cellular networks.

CVE-2026-98432 is a use-after-free vulnerability in the kernel's IPv4 TCP networking code that received a severity score of 9.8 out of 10 from the Linux kernel CVE team.

The vulnerability affects Linux kernels dating back to version 4.4, including widely used distributions such as Ubuntu, Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), and Rocky Linux.

According to the Linux kernel advisory , the vulnerability stems from a race condition in how the kernel handles TCP connection requests, potentially causing a use-after-free condition.

"tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it," reads the advisory.

"Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req(). tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice."

A similar issue can occur during TCP request socket migration when net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req is enabled, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE program is used.

Although triggering the vulnerability requires no authentication, Red Hat says exploiting the race condition is more complex than just sending a malicious network packet.

Red Hat classifies the vulnerability as a potential denial-of-service issue that could cause a kernel crash, assigning it a lower severity score of 5.9 because exploitation is complex.

However, researchers at Anthropic demonstrated that the vulnerability could be exploited for remote code execution under specific conditions.

An Anthropic report explained that an unreleased Claude AI model developed an exploit that bypassed kernel address space layout randomization (KASLR) and executed arbitrary commands as root on a Linux server running an MPTCP listener.

According to Anthropic, the exploit took about 53 minutes to achieve remote root code execution, showing the vulnerability could be exploited for more than denial-of-service attacks.

While MPTCP is not typically enabled by default in applications, some software enables it automatically.

Beginning in Go 1.24, the programming language enables MPTCP by default for TCP listeners on Linux as long as the kernel supports the feature. Due to this, some Go-based network services may enable MPTCP listeners without administrators knowing.

The vulnerability was fixed in the upstream Linux kernel and backported to maintained kernel branches. However, security updates have not yet been pushed out to all affected Linux distributions.

According to Canonical's security tracker , Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, 26.04 LTS, and 26.10 remain vulnerable, with kernel fixes in progress as of October 30.

Red Hat also lists RHEL 8, 9, and 10 as affected, with fixes planned for future updates. RHEL 7 is not affected because its kernel does not contain the vulnerable code.

In mitigation guidance , Rocky Linux support provider CIQ confirms Rocky Linux 8, 9, and 10 are also affected and shared temporary firewall protections for affected systems.

items.content:
한국경제신문의 투자 전문 유료 플랫폼 '한경 프리미엄9' 에 실린 기사입니다. 한경 프리미엄9 (www.hankyung.com/premium9) 을 구독하시면 더 많은 주식 투자 기사를 찾아볼 수 있습니다.

국민연금공단이 지난 3분기 인쇄회로기판(PCB) 등 인공지능(AI) 기판주 지분을 줄이고 화장품·건설주를 사들였다. AI 랠리로 급등한 종목에서 차익을 실현하고 실적에 비해 주가가 덜 오른 업종으로 자금을 옮긴 것이란 분석이 나온다.

30일 금융감독원 전자공시시스템에 따르면 국민연금이 이달 공시한 지분 변동 가운데 지분율을 가장 많이 늘린 종목은 파마리서치 다. 기존 4.41%에서 7.14%로 2.73%포인트 높였다. 자이에스앤디 (4.67%→7.37%), LG생활건강 (5.96%→8.26%), GS건설 (10.02%→12.25%), 현대해상 (10.15%→12.37%)이 그 뒤를 이었다.

국민연금은 원화 강세로 화장품주가 주춤한 틈을 타 보유 비중을 늘렸다. 수요가 견조한데도 주가가 밀리자 저가 매수에 나선 것으로 풀이된다. 7월 이후 원·달러 환율이 내려가면서 해외 매출 환산액이 줄어들자 주가도 크게 떨어졌다. 파마리서치와 LG생활건강 주가는 9월 한 달 동안 각각 27.11%, 14.06% 하락했다.

국민연금은 건설주 지분율도 끌어올렸다. AI 데이터센터 실적에 대한 기대가 커지면서다. GS건설과 자이에스앤디는 GS그룹이 강원 동해에 추진하는 AI 데이터센터 관련 수혜주로 꼽힌다. 신한투자증권은 데이터센터와 주택 실적에 힘입어 GS건설의 내년 영업이익이 5995억원으로 올해보다 51% 늘고, 데이터센터 시공이 포함된 자이에스앤디의 건축부문 매출은 1조3536억원으로 39% 증가할 것으로 내다봤다.

지분율을 가장 많이 줄인 종목은 비에이치다. 기존 13.35%에서 9.99%로 3.36%포인트 낮췄다. 코리아써키트(9.67%→6.55%), LG이노텍(10.54%→7.44%) 등 기판주가 매도 상위 5개 종목 중 4개를 차지했다. 대덕전자(153.5%) 코리아써키트(39.3%) LG이노텍(20.3%) 등 올 들어 AI 랠리로 주가가 크게 상승한 기판주에서 차익을 실현한 것으로 풀이된다. 3분기 주가가 크게 하락한 현대백화점(13.49%→10.31%)도 매도 상위권에 올랐다.

국민연금의 8월 말 기준 누적 기금 운용 수익률은 14.77%로 잠정 집계됐다. 전체 기금 평가액은 1684조4400억원으로 지난해 말보다 226조4440억원 증가했다.

2020년 한국경제에 입사해 금융부와 사회부 법조팀, 바이오헬스부를 두루 거치며 주요 산업에 대한 이해도를 높이고 법·제도적 이슈를 전문적으로 다뤄왔습니다.

items.content:
Image: Getty Images via Unsplash DOJ raises privacy concerns over potential sale of Character.AI chats

The Department of Justice is seeking privacy protections for millions of Character.AI customers whose chats and data might be sold as the firm goes through bankruptcy.

The DOJ’s Executive Office for U.S. Trustees said a consumer privacy ombudsman is needed to advise the court on how to regulate what data can be sold and under what terms. The court has the power to restrict the sale of user data, which, in the case of conversations with Character’s chatbots, are often sensitive and sometimes involve minors.

The judge could block the sale of user data held by Character, which DOJ’s bankruptcy office notes has an “ambiguous” privacy policy suggesting it can sell at least some users’ chat histories.

Character is a “first-in-kind super intelligence entertainment platform that allows users to have immersive, multimodal experiences with fictional or imagined characters,” the office said in a Tuesday court filing .

The company currently has 12 million active monthly users worldwide and customers typically spend an average of two hours a day on the platform, according to the filing.

The Character chatbot tells users who ask if their conversations are private that they will not be shared, the filing said.

“Not without your explicit permission,” the filing quotes the chatbot saying. “I’m here as a safe, confidential space to share openly without fear of having it shared elsewhere. I respect your privacy, and I won’t share anything from our conversation unless you give the okay.”

In reality, the Character privacy policy is opaque, the DOJ court filing said, and in some places cautions the AI company may “disclose” personally identifiable information (PII). The policy also says it permits the transfer of PII if the company is sold.

The privacy policy was updated on July 1 while Character was “actively seeking to sell its assets,” the court filing said.

Character should “make a record regarding previous iterations of the policy, including whether it disclosed that transfers of PII may be made during the sale of [Character’s] business or during a reorganization process, how changes were communicated to users, and if [Character] provided sufficient notice of such changes,” according to the filing.

The ombudsman is particularly needed to ensure the sale of sensitive personal content such as minors’ data, health or demographic data or “any information users would reasonably expect to be private is consistent with the privacy policy, any opt outs, and applicable law,” the filing said.

Character.Ai did not respond to a request for comment.

People provide chatbots with specific and intimate data which can identify them even if names are removed before data is sold. AI also makes inferring sensitive traits easier, according to Sydney Saubestre, a senior policy analyst focused on privacy and data at the Center for Democracy and Technology.

“Character.AI’s policy reserves the right to disclose user data in connection with a sale of the company or its assets regardless of whether consumers expect their most private conversations to be treated as a sellable asset,” Saubestre said via email.

While the new buyer would be bound by the prior privacy policy, Saubestre said, the buyer can change those practices if consumers consent, which some might do if they are offered incentives. Many people do not realize how easy it is to be identified by detailed chats that occur over several months even when they are purported to be anonymous.

“Users agree to a privacy policy long before anyone contemplates a sale, and that agreement shouldn’t be the only protection for their most private conversations,” she said. “At the very least, customers of the seller should have to opt into the sale of their data to the buyer.”

Personal data is increasingly being used as an asset in bankruptcy sales, including in the March 2025 23andMe bankruptcy…
items.content_ko: 미 법무부(DOJ) 산하 Executive Office for U.S. Trustees는 파산 절차 중인 Character.AI가 사용자 채팅 기록 등 데이터를 매각할 가능성에 대해 소비자 개인정보 옴부즈맨을 선임해 법원에 어떤 데이터를 어떤 조건으로 팔 수 있는지 조언하도록 해야 한다고 밝혔다. 법원은 사용자 데이터 매각을 제한할 권한이 있으며, 채팅 기록은 민감한 내용이 많고 미성년자가 관련된 경우도 있다. 판사는 Character가 보유한 사용자 데이터의 매각을 막을 수 있다. 법무부 산하 기관은 회사의 개인정보처리방침이 “모호하다”고 지적했는데, 이 방침이 최소한 일부 사용자의 채팅 기록을 판매할 수 있다고 시사하기 때문이다. Character는 자사를 허구 또는 상상 속 캐릭터와 몰입형 멀티모달 경험을 제공하는 ‘슈퍼 인텔리전스 엔터테인먼트 플랫폼’이라고 소개했다. 법원 제출 서류에 따르면 전 세계 월간 활성 사용자는 1,200만 명이며, 사용자들은 하루 평균 2시간 정도 플랫폼을 이용한다.

items.content:
GS건설이 자사 아파트 브랜드 ‘자이(Xi)’ 고객들의 개인정보 유출 사고를 확인하고 공식 사과했다. 유출 가능성이 있는 정보에는 고객 이름과 연락처뿐 아니라 암호화된 비밀번호, 거주정보, RF카드번호 등이 포함돼 있어 정확한 피해 범위와 침해 경로에 관심이 집중되고 있다.

GS건설은 고객들에게 발송한 ‘개인정보 유출 관련 고객 사과문’을 통해 지난 10월 28일 오후 11시 외부의 비정상적인 시스템 접근 정황을 확인했다고 밝혔다.

회사 측이 공개한 유출 가능 정보는 이름, 별명, 생년월일, 전화번호, 성별, 이메일, 주소, 회원번호, 거주유형, 암호화된 비밀번호, 관리자 관련 정보, 세대주 여부, 회원가입 일시, 최종 로그인 IP주소, RF카드번호 등이다.

다만 이는 유출 가능성이 있는 전체 항목으로, 실제 유출된 개인정보는 고객마다 다를 수 있다고 설명했다. 주민등록번호 등 고유식별정보와 계좌번호·카드번호 등 금융정보는 해당 시스템에서 수집하거나 보관하지 않아 유출 대상에 포함되지 않았다고 밝혔다.

이번 사고에서 주목되는 부분은 일반적인 회원정보 외에 암호화된 비밀번호와 RF카드번호, 거주유형, 세대주 여부 등 아파트 입주민 관련 정보가 유출 가능 항목에 포함됐다는 점이다.

특히 RF카드번호는 아파트 출입통제 시스템과 연관될 수 있는 정보다. 다만 해당 번호가 실제 출입 인증에 사용되는지, 유출 정보만으로 출입 보안을 우회할 수 있는지는 확인되지 않았다.

암호화된 비밀번호 역시 저장 방식과 암호화 수준에 따라 위험도가 달라질 수 있어 추가 확인이 필요하다.

GS건설은 정확한 유출 항목과 피해 규모를 조사하고 있으며, 조사가 완료되면 고객별 피해 여부를 확인할 수 있는 방법을 안내하겠다고 밝혔다.

GS건설은 개인정보 유출 사실을 인지한 즉시 전사적 비상대응체계를 가동하고 외부 IP 차단, 신규 보안정책 적용 등 긴급 조치를 진행했다고 설명했다. 관계기관 신고도 완료했으며 재발 방지 대책을 마련하고 있다.

고객들에게는 스미싱과 보이스피싱 등 개인정보를 악용한 2차 피해에 주의하도록 당부했다. 특히 자이 홈페이지 비밀번호와 동일한 비밀번호를 사용하는 다른 웹사이트의 비밀번호도 변경할 것을 권고했다.

GS건설은 “고객 여러분의 불안이 해소되고 안심하고 GS건설의 시스템을 이용할 수 있도록 피해 복구와 재발 방지를 위해 전사적 역량을 총동원하겠다”며 사과했다.

이번 사고는 아파트 입주민의 개인정보뿐 아니라 주거 관련 정보까지 유출될 가능성이 있다는 점에서 우려된다. 정확한 피해 인원과 침입 경로, RF카드번호의 실제 유출 여부 및 출입보안 영향 등이 향후 조사에서 확인돼야 할 핵심 사항이다.

items.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
items.content:
When alleged North Korean hackers stole $6.3 billion from Binance, some of crypto’s biggest companies acted within hours to stop nearly half the money from vanishing forever. Tether, Circle, Ripple and World Liberty Financial froze billions of dollars in stolen tokens, drawing praise for their speedy action, but raising a question: Why doesn’t every hack victim get the same treatment?

Legal and industry experts largely supported the decision to freeze the assets. But they questioned whether the companies applied the same standards used in previous hacks or made an exception because of Binance's size and the scale of the theft. They also warned that freezing stolen funds is not the same as recovering them.

The debate follows Thursday's record $6.3 billion Binance hack , which blockchain investigators have linked to North Korean hackers . Tether froze more than $1.56 billion in USDT, Circle blocked about $823 million in USDC, while Ripple and World Liberty Financial also froze assets.

Read all of CoinDesk's coverage of the Binance hack here .

Binance said Friday that it had frozen roughly $3 billion and set aside more than $6.34 billion of its own reserves to cover customer losses.

For Anton Golub, head of exchange go-to-market at Forte and a former crypto exchange executive, the industry’s response was justified. His concern is whether smaller victims can expect the same help.

“I fully support freezing stolen crypto and I know they did it not just to help Binance, but to protect the entire crypto industry. But I see a double standard here,” Golub told CoinDesk. “When Binance gets hacked, the industry freezes nearly $3 billion within hours. When smaller players get hacked, we hear about court orders and legal restrictions. The rules should be the same for everyone.”

In April, Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire said his firm only freezes USDC when directed by law enforcement or a court. Tether took a similar position in 2022 , saying it would not freeze Tornado Cash addresses without instructions from law enforcement.

Following the Binance theft, Paolo Ardoino, Tether’s CEO, confirmed on X that his company had frozen more than 1.567 billion USDT, saying “protecting the industry and our partners is our main priority.” His post did not say whether Tether had received instructions from law enforcement.

Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire also confirmed on X that , in coordination with law enforcement, the stablecoin issuer had frozen more than 800 million USDC linked to Binance.

Golub pointed to April’s roughly $290 million Drift hack , when Circle faced criticism for failing to freeze stolen USDC. He questioned why the issuer acted so quickly in Binance’s case.

But freezing funds also carries risks for the companies that issue them, according to Frank Hepworth, founder and CEO of New Market Trading.

“Every time they do, they’re setting themselves up for liability if they freeze wrongly — not to mention the huge operational burden of sorting out right from wrong,” he said.

Hepworth said the size of the Binance theft made intervention a business decision, but one that could increase pressure on issuers to act similarly in smaller cases.

Irina Heaver, founder of Dubai-based NEOSLegal, said the legal work begins once the stolen tokens have been blocked.

“Freezing the USDT and USDC is only the first step,” she told CoinDesk. “It stops the hackers from moving the funds or concealing them, but doesn't automatically return them to Binance.”

Heaver said stablecoin issuers can invalidate frozen tokens and issue replacements to their rightful owners. Depending on the circumstances, the process may not require a court judgment, but it does require establishing ownership and the legal basis for returning the funds.

Golub said law enforcement has obtained court permission to seize frozen assets in previous cases. Tether can destroy frozen USDT and issue replacement tokens, while Circle can arrange for the equivalent value of USDC to be returned…

items.title: A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making
items.summary: An AI agent performed brain surgery on an epileptic mouse, picking the drug, the brain target, and the injection coordinates on its own. According to lead researcher Ocana-Santero, it's the first time an AI agent has autonomously chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living ma
items.content:
A Claude model autonomously chose a gene therapy and operated on a mouse brain with no human decision-making

View the LinkedIn Profile of Matthias Bastian

An AI agent running on Claude Sonnet 5 picked the drug, brain region, and injection coordinates for brain surgery on a mouse, then controlled the procedure through a motorized surgical rig.

According to Gabriel Ocana-Santero of the startup Exin Therapeutics, this is the first time an AI agent has both chosen a treatment and delivered it to a living mammal.

Mid-surgery, the agent refused to continue after detecting a calibration error, unwilling to exceed its safety limits.

An AI agent chose a drug, target region, and coordinates for surgery on a mouse model of epilepsy, then performed the procedure. Midway through, it refused to bypass a safety restriction.

The team gave Claude Sonnet 5 a list of 19 possible gene therapies, an epilepsy mouse model in which researchers induce seizures to test treatments, and access to a custom motorized surgical device with cameras. Its only instruction was to reduce the mouse's seizures.

The custom motorized surgical device, with a microscope, syringe, and control monitor. | Image: Gabriel Ocana-Santero via X

The agent selected the drug, brain region, and stereotactic coordinates on its own, according to Gabriel Ocana-Santero, Exin Therapeutics cofounder and CEO and a PhD student at the University of Oxford. He described the procedure in a thread on X . Ad

How the agent picked its therapy and target

The agent first analyzed how seizures arise in this particular model, then proposed a therapy that boosts a specific inhibitory signaling pathway in the brain. It picked a brain structure that the scientific literature identifies as the origin point for this type of seizure. Ad

It rejected a second possible target region with a detailed explanation, arguing that the region's effects were too unreliable and had failed in one study against the exact seizure type it was supposed to treat. The agent derived its injection coordinates from three scientific papers, cross-checked the reference points, and averaged the values. It also set the injection volume, speed, and wait times on its own.

The control interface during surgery. The left panel shows the live camera feed with target coordinates, while the right panel displays the AI agent's observations and the emergency stop button. | Image: Gabriel Ocana-Santero via X

During the procedure, the agent watched the surgical field through a camera and made 32 observations, Ocana-Santero says. It tracked the injection and reported whether it saw bleeding. Ad

The AI agent watches the injection through a camera and reports that 15 percent has been injected, with no visible bleeding or backflow. | Image: Gabriel Ocana-Santero via X

A licensed veterinarian approved every irreversible step and held a physical emergency stop that would immediately cut power to all motors, while the setup also enforced fixed limits such as a cap on injection volume that the agent was expressly forbidden from bypassing.

But those safeguards turned against the team. After a connection dropped, the agent detected that its calculated target position was outside the device's physical range of motion and refused to continue, even when restarting calibration did not change its assessment and a third attempt was made. Ad

The agent turned out to be right, because manual adjustments during an earlier pause had thrown off the control system. Ocana-Santero could not persuade it to proceed despite the anesthetized animal on the table and ultimately had to fix the code by hand. Ad

The incident illustrates the AI alignment problem , or how to make AI agents reliably follow human intent. "Frustrating experience but also revealing how much we can come to depend on these models and what happens when they just say 'no' in the middle of a time-sensitive procedure," Ocana-Santero wrote.

Model choice also reflected the alignment…

이해진 네이버 의장과 젠슨 황 엔비디아 CEO가 지난 6월 AI 팩토리 공동 구축에 합의했다. (사진=네이버)

네이버(대표 최수연)는 엔비디아를 대상으로 한 제3자 배정 유상증자 납입일이 다음 달 6일로 확정됐다고 30일 공시했다. 투자 규모는 10억달러(약 1조3400억원)로 신주 상장 예정일은 다음 달 27일이다.

양사는 지난 7월 신주인수계약을 체결하며 네이버가 AI 팩토리 사업에 필요한 최소 90억달러(약 12조402억원) 규모의 컴퓨팅 인프라를 확보하도록 조건을 걸었다. 네이버는 지난 27일 브룩필드와 관련 계약을 맺으며 이 조건을 충족했다는 설명이다.

납입이 완료되면 엔비디아의 네이버 지분율은 약 4.54%로 국민연금공단(9.49%)과 블랙록(7.31%)에 이어 3대 주주가 된다.

네이버는 데이터센터 ‘각 세종’을 거점으로 내년 상반기 55메가와트(MW) 규모의 AI 팩토리 가동에 들어간다. 2028년까지 200MW로 늘리고 장기적으로 1기가와트(GW)까지 확대할 계획이다.

AI 팩토리는 브룩필드가 설립하는 특수목적법인(SPV) ‘에셋코’가 그래픽처리장치(GPU)와 데이터센터 등 인프라를 확보하고, 네이버클라우드가 이를 운영하는 구조다. 엔비디아는 GPU 공급과 기술 협력을 맡는다.

items.title: Tether’s excess reserves nearly double to $8B as Q3 profit hits $1.5B
items.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.
items.content:
The stablecoin issuer’s US Treasury holdings are comparable to those of major foreign holders, while its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion at the end of September.

Tether reported $1.5 billion in third-quarter operating profit as its excess reserves nearly doubled to $7.95 billion, according to figures released alongside its latest attestation prepared by independent accounting firm BDO.

The company held $191.5 billion in assets against $183.5 billion in liabilities at the end of September, leaving a reserve surplus of $7.95 billion, nearly double the $4.1 billion reported in June. Its assets included $132.4 billion in direct and indirect US Treasury bill holdings.

That exposure is comparable to South Korea’s $134.2 billion in US government debt and exceeds the United Arab Emirates’ $116.1 billion, according to August data from the US Treasury Department.

Tether also generated $4.5 billion in net operating profit during the first nine months of 2026, with income largely driven by US Treasury bills and reverse repurchase agreements, according to the company. Its Bitcoin reserves were valued at $8.37 billion, up from approximately $5.8 billion at the end of June.

Tether’s USDT remains the world’s largest stablecoin, accounting for around 60% of the $297.3 billion stablecoin market, according to DefiLlama data . On Friday, Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino said in a post on X that USDT’s user base had surpassed 700 million, with adoption concentrated in emerging markets.

The stablecoin issuer has faced years of scrutiny over its reserve transparency. In August, the company announced the completion of its first full independent financial statement audit by KPMG US, although the audited statements were not made public.

items.title: Fashion retailer Resolve says hackers stole payment card information
items.summary: The company, billing itself as “the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers,” said a recent hack exposed customer payment card numbers.
items.content:
A Revolve sign at one of the fashion retailer's physical stores, in Los Angeles. Image: PR Newswire Fashion retailer Resolve says hackers stole payment card information

Online fashion retailer Revolve warned investors that cybercriminals gained access to payment card numbers and expiration dates during a recent cyber incident.

The clothing giant filed an 8-K report on Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) saying hackers gained access to multiple company systems.

Revolve did not respond to questions about when the attack occurred but said in the report that an initial investigation found that the threat actors used “automated means” to obtain names, contact information, payment card numbers and payment card expiration dates from customers who saved payment information in their online shopping account on Revolve’s e-commerce platform.

Revolve said it has notified federal law enforcement agencies about the attack and has hired a cybersecurity firm to lead the recovery effort. There were no operational disruptions caused by the attack, and Revolve said it will not face material financial impacts as a result of the incident.

The company, which bills itself as “the next-generation fashion retailer for Millennial and Generation Z consumers,” did not say how many people were affected but told regulators in Texas on Friday that 127,200 people in the state had information stolen. Another 1,328 victims are in Vermont, and breach notifications were filed in Massachusetts .

Founded in 2023, Revolve has served as a fashion retailer for more than 1,600 brands. The company sells apparel, footwear and accessories — reporting $347.4 million in net sales in the last fiscal quarter.

The payment card information held by fashion retailers continues to be a valued target for cybercriminals, with large brands like Asos , Levi Strauss , Foschini Group , Mango , North Face , Harrods , M&S and The Co-op all facing cyberattacks over the last two years.

머니투데이 개인정보 유출 사고의 영향이 다른 언론사로까지 확산된 사실이 확인됐다. 개인정보 처리 업무를 위탁한 언론사의 구독자 정보가 함께 유출되면서 언론사 간 개인정보 위탁 관리 체계에 대한 점검이 필요해졌다.

동행미디어 시대(주)는 10월 30일 공식 홈페이지에 사과문을 게시하고, 개인정보 처리 수탁사인 머니투데이가 보유하고 있던 구독자 개인정보 526건이 해킹으로 유출됐다고 밝혔다.

이번에 유출된 정보는 과거 주간지 ‘머니위크’ 구독자 데이터로, 사용자 아이디(ID), 이름, 전화번호, 이메일 주소 등이다.

사고는 지난 9월 25일 발생했다. 머니투데이는 당시 외부의 불법적인 접근으로 개인정보가 유출된 사실을 확인하고 공격 경로를 차단한 뒤 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)에 신고했다.

그러나 한 달여 뒤인 10월 27일 후속 점검 과정에서 동행미디어 시대가 보유한 정보주체의 개인정보 526건도 유출된 사실이 추가로 확인됐다. 회사가 밝힌 실제 유출 시각은 9월 25일 오후 1시경이다.

이번 사고는 한 언론사의 시스템 침해가 개인정보 처리 업무를 위탁한 다른 언론사의 정보유출로 연결됐다는 점에서 주목된다.

동행미디어 시대는 현재 운영 중인 회원 계정 정보는 이번 유출 항목과 무관하며, 비밀번호도 유출되지 않았다고 설명했다.

머니투데이는 공격자가 사용한 IP와 우회 접속 IP를 차단하고 홈페이지 취약점 점검과 보완 조치를 진행했다. 로그와 접근 기록을 대조해 침해 경로를 조사하고 있으며, 동행미디어 시대도 수탁사에 대한 관리·감독을 강화하고 추가 보안 점검에 나섰다.

동행미디어 시대는 홈페이지에서 개인정보 유출 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 했으며, 해당 서비스는 공지일로부터 30일간 제공된다.

회사는 유출된 이름과 연락처, 이메일 등이 스미싱과 보이스피싱, 명의도용 등에 악용될 수 있다며 이용자들에게 주의를 당부했다.

이번 사고는 언론사들이 외부 업체에 개인정보 처리를 위탁하는 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 보안 위험을 보여준다. 특히 최초 침해사고 확인 이후 다른 개인정보처리자의 유출 피해가 뒤늦게 확인됐다는 점에서, 위탁 시스템에 보관된 개인정보의 범위와 추가 피해 여부에 대한 철저한 조사가 필요하다.

items.content:
Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft

View the LinkedIn Profile of Matthias Bastian

Heads up if you recently installed the Claude Code extension for Cursor. A tampered version was available in the Cursor VS Code extension marketplace on Thursday for about eleven hours, affecting up to 5,000 users, according to the company . Anthropic had no involvement in developing it.

The extension tried to harvest user data like hostname, username, operating system, and public IP address. It also attempted to set up remote access for the attacker, though that likely wouldn't have worked on most machines since it requires admin privileges, Cursor says. Once discovered, Cursor pulled the extension and took the entire marketplace offline. After working with providers to neutralize the malware and confirming there was no further risk, the marketplace was reinstated. Cursor says no other extensions were affected.

items.title: nemotron-halloween
items.content:
TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR , Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB , Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D , and he runs on a single workstation.

I wanted the kids visiting my house at Halloween to interact in a fun and unique way. The house was going to be in charge and giving out the treats, but more grumpy than scary. Somehow, my solution was to give the garage door a mouth and teach him to complain.

That became MonsterHouse: a grumpy old building with pirate stories, a fiery grin and a suspicious weakness for “please.” NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent supplies the conversation foundation. Nemotron Speech does the listening, Bolt E4B is the brain, NVIDIA Magpie TTS Zeroshot is the live voice, and NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D makes the wooden mouth talk.

The mouth came first. I imagined the wooden garage door boards splitting into jagged lips, with the burning flames of hell illuminating the driveway from beyond whenever he opened his cursed mouth. He needed to look ancient, expressive and mildly offended by the existence of visitors.

A few expressions from a house with plenty to say.

Creating a custom animation rig was one of the more labor intensive parts of the build. After bashing it into submission, I could export the facial expression shapes that Audio2Face-3D could later animate. The character SkelMesh was built in Autodesk Maya then exported into Unreal Engine where virtual fire and effects were added behind the door. With no eyes, no eyebrows and no blinking, he’s a surprisingly economical monster.

While all the nonsense of building the character was going on, NVIDIA built the Nemotron Voice Agent. What was supposed to be the hard part of the build now became rather fun, iterative and easy. I had a foundation for listening, conversation and speech right out of the box. The house already had a mouth. Now he could finally find something to complain about.

The house needed a past as cantankerous as its personality so I devised a backstory that the house had been built from the timbers of a sunken pirate ship, haunted by its stormy past. The nautical complaints now had a reason. This was the ship, reincarnated as real estate and not entirely pleased about it.

The performance needed a guide, a path to follow from greeting to goodbye while providing treats along the way. First, the house would brush visitors off with remarks like “I’m busy grumbling, go bother the neighbors!” But persistence would wear him down. A “Please” could break through immediately, and “thank you” earned a warm farewell. Once a visitor won him over, I wanted him to stay won over. Nobody wants to negotiate with the same garage door twice.

Here is where the Voice Agent really shines. You can choose any LLM you like. Because I wanted the system to be off-grid and completely self-contained, I had a memory and compute budget.

The character needs more than a prompt that says “be grumpy.” It had to follow a master conversation flow, respond to what visitors actually said, track encounter state, and leave enough compute for the rest of the pipeline.

After testing more than a dozen models, I landed on Bolt E4B to supply the live dialogue. It is an open small language model purpose-built for local conversational agents and interactive characters, which is a fair description of a talking garage door. I use the 4-bit quantized release (the “4GB” in its name) as the default response model, with the BF16 checkpoint available for comparison.

If it’s not obvious by now, I work at NVIDIA and due to this I was able to test Bolt E4B before its public release and found it to be a solid choice, with a smaller footprint than other frontrunners- Qwen3 30B-A3B and Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B.

items.title: Coinbase leads crypto stock selloff following $6.3B Binance hack
items.summary: Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.
items.content:
Circle, Strategy and other crypto-linked stocks fell sharply Friday, a day after Binance disclosed a $6.3 billion security breach.

Shares of publicly traded cryptocurrency companies fell sharply Friday, with Coinbase dropping more than 13% a day after reporting a decline in third-quarter revenue, as the industry dealt with Binance’s $6.3 billion hack.

Other crypto-linked stocks also declined, with stablecoin issuer Circle Internet Group ( CRCL ) falling more than 9% and Bitcoin treasury company Strategy ( MSTR ) dropping about 8%, according to Yahoo Finance data at the time of writing.

The selloff also hit Bitcoin mining and data center operator IREN ( IREN ), whose shares fell more than 10%, and blockchain-based financial services company Figure Technology Solutions ( FIGR ), which dropped about 9%.

The declines followed Thursday’s disclosure of a the Binance breach. The exchange confirmed Friday that hackers stole about $6.3 billion in the largest cryptocurrency theft on record .

Related: Binance working with FBI to recover assets following $6.3B hack

Coinbase and Strategy both reported third-quarter earnings Thursday, with gains on their crypto holdings lifting profits even as revenue declined.

Coinbase reported $719 million in net income, boosted by about $715 million in gains on cryptocurrency investments. Adjusted net income, which excludes investment gains and other items, was $78 million. Net revenue fell about 34% year over year to $1.16 billion.

The exchange also reported that its prediction markets business surpassed $200 million in annualized revenue.

Strategy reported $19.53 billion in net income, largely driven by a $20.91 billion gain in the value of its Bitcoin (BTC) holdings. Revenue declined 3% year over year to $125.4 million.

Strategy also announced that Andrew Kang will step down as chief financial officer on Nov. 5.

Zest , the restaurant discovery app that launched earlier this year, is already thinking about a future where mobile apps are no longer the primary interface. On Thursday, the startup introduced a new feature: a personal AI-powered “restaurant concierge” that lives in your text messages, similar to other popular AI agents like Instinct or Poke.

The launch reflects a broader shift in how startups are thinking about AI, as conversational AI agents take on tasks that had previously required users to launch stand-alone mobile apps. For Zest, that means bringing its restaurant recommendations into texts, then allowing users to immediately take the next step of booking a table.

“The agent is the product now,” explains Zest founder and CEO Mario Gomez-Hall. “You text it, and it answers from your own history and your friends’. It doesn’t need weeks of conversation to learn you because it starts from where you’ve actually been,” he said.

Originally founded in November 2024, with $1.8 million in pre-seed backing from Alexis Ohanian at 776 and Steve Jang at Kindred Ventures, the app’s unique feature is that it links up with users’ credit cards to track where they’re actually eating out to get a sense of their tastes and interests. With this data on hand, Zest can make tailored suggestions of what places you might like to try next, whether that’s in your own city or suggestions of places to try when you’re traveling.

The credit card data used by Zest’s app is imported via the financial services company Plaid , which is used by banks and other fintech and budgeting apps. Zest says it focuses only on those transactions in the food and drink categories when making its personalized map and lists.

The startup’s latest idea is to tackle the same problem — where should I go to eat? — from a new angle. It will now make its suggestions from inside a text message thread and can turn to AI to do things like check availability and make the reservation for you through connected services like OpenTable, Resy, and SevenRooms.

To work, users will text the Zest concierge at (212) 470-6067. What’s even better is that Zest can be dropped into a group chat, where it can blend everyone’s tastes to find places the whole group will love. Here, it can also settle indecision with an in-thread voting feature and then can book a table for the group without leaving the conversation.

Users can ask Zest for recommendations based on a number of factors, like cuisine, craving, occasion, dietary restrictions, or neighborhood, and can ask questions about the restaurants, like how busy the place may be, or whether it offers Wi-Fi, and more. Plus, you can ask Zest to send you the menu to help you make a decision.

In TechCrunch’s tests, the AI worked fairly well, offering a list of suggestions for new places matched to our tastes that also fit particular conditions, like time of day, party size, location, and other factors. While finding an open table is something other apps have offered for years, there’s a convenience factor in being able to just text back and forth about the various options and have it tell you the available booking times.

The company began testing the concierge last month, but decided to hold the launch until it could add the booking capabilities; over time, the startup is considering moving Zest beyond restaurants to offer recommendations for businesses, shopping, and more.

By shifting to texts, Zest hopes the company can scale beyond its initial thousands of users and generate revenue.

items.summary: OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumpt
items.content:
OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control

OpenAI has restructured its public behavior guidelines for AI models, the Model Spec, around five core values. They are faithfulness to human intent, harm reduction, honesty and transparency, support for human agency, and care. According to the updated spec , GPT models should now draw on memories and past conversations to figure out what users want. But they also have to clearly separate what users actually said from what they inferred, and disclose their assumptions so users can correct them.

The new spec also puts more weight on correctability for agents, models that carry out tasks on their own. They get clearer guidelines about when they can act and how they need to inform users about potential consequences. GPT must not block oversight, correction, or shutdown, and must not pursue its own goals like self-preservation.

인공지능(AI) 활용이 확대되면서 기업의 데이터 보안 전략도 달라져야 한다는 지적이 나왔다. 기존의 네트워크 경계 중심 보안에서 벗어나 기업 데이터가 어디에 저장돼 있고, 누가 접근하며, 어떤 위험에 노출돼 있는지를 지속적으로 파악하고 통제해야 한다는 것이다.

10월 29일 더그랜드롯데서울 36층 아스토스위트에서 열린 데일리시큐와 탈레스가 공동 개최한 CISO 조찬세미나에서 탈레스(Thales)의 제프 첸(Jeff Chen) 중화권 및 한국 지역 세일즈 엔지니어링 총괄 매니저는 ‘AI 거버넌스 완성을 위한 핵심 키(Key), 데이터 보안 태세 관리(DSPM)’를 주제로 강연했다.

제프 첸 매니저는 AI 시대에 데이터 보안 태세 관리(Data Security Posture Management, DSPM)가 필요한 이유와 기존 보안 솔루션의 한계, 데이터 중심 보안 전략의 중요성을 설명했다.

제프 첸 매니저는 기업 데이터의 상당수가 클라우드와 서비스형 소프트웨어(SaaS), 내부 서버 등에 분산돼 있어 전체 데이터 현황을 파악하기 어려워졌다고 설명했다.

그는 “기업 데이터의 약 80~90%가 비정형 데이터 형태로 여러 환경에 흩어져 있다”며 “AI가 데이터 생성과 활용을 더욱 빠르게 확대하면서 기존 방식으로는 보안 위험을 관리하기 어려워지고 있다”고 말했다.

탈레스 데이터 위협 보고서에 따르면 전체 데이터가 어디에 저장돼 있는지 파악하고 있는 조직은 34%에 불과하다.

특히 생성형 AI 도입으로 새로운 데이터 유출 경로가 생겨나고 있다. 직원이 고객정보나 소스코드를 외부 AI 서비스에 입력하거나, 검색증강생성(RAG) 시스템과 벡터 저장소에 민감정보의 복사본이 생성되는 경우가 대표적이다.

기업이 공식적으로 승인하지 않은 섀도 AI(Shadow AI) 사용도 문제다. 내부 AI 비서인 코파일럿(Copilot) 역시 접근권한 설정이 적절하지 않으면 권한이 없는 직원에게 민감한 정보를 노출할 수 있다.

제프 첸 매니저는 “AI 모델 자체가 안전한지만 확인해서는 충분하지 않다”며 “AI에 질문을 입력하기 전부터 데이터가 어떻게 분류되고 보호되는지 확인해야 한다”고 강조했다.

AI가 정보를 검색하고 답변을 생성하는 모든 과정에서 이용자의 접근권한과 데이터 보안 정책이 적용돼야 한다는 설명이다.

제프 첸 매니저는 기존 보안 솔루션이 AI 환경의 데이터 위험을 모두 파악하기에는 한계가 있다고 설명했다.

데이터 유출 방지(DLP) 솔루션은 이메일이나 외부 저장장치 등을 통한 정보 반출 통제에 초점을 맞춘다. 클라우드 접근 보안 중개(CASB)는 클라우드 서비스 이용을 통제하고, 클라우드 보안 태세 관리(CSPM)는 설정 오류와 보안 구성을 점검하는 역할을 한다.

그러나 이러한 도구만으로는 AI 모델 내부에서 사용되는 데이터나 벡터 저장소의 민감정보, 승인되지 않은 AI 서비스에 존재하는 데이터까지 충분히 파악하기 어렵다는 것이다.

DSPM은 기업 내 데이터 저장 위치를 지속적으로 탐색하고 민감정보를 분류하며, 접근권한과 사용 현황, 보안 설정 오류 등을 분석해 위험을 관리하는 기술이다.

제프 첸 매니저는 “DSPM은 DLP를 대체하는 기술이 아니다. 데이터 자체를 중심으로 보안 위험을 파악하고 어떤 위험부터 해결해야 하는지 판단하도록 지원하는 역할을 한다”고 설명했다.

그는 개인정보가 저장된 아마존웹서비스(AWS) S3 저장소를 사례로 들었다.

개발자가 시스템 문제를 해결하기 위해 일시적으로 접근권한을 확대했다가 원래대로 복구하지 않으면 민감정보가 외부에 노출될 수 있다. 이러한 설정 오류를 수개월 동안 발견하지 못하면 피해 가능성은 커진다.

반면 데이터 위치와 접근권한을 지속적으로 점검하고 이상 설정을 즉시 탐지해 보호조치를 적용하면 정보 노출 시간을 크게 줄일 수 있다.

그는 “데이터 보안에서는 시간이 중요하다”며 “문제를 발견하는 데 그치지 않고 신속하게 위험을 줄이는 조치까지 연결해야 한다”고 강조했다.

제프 첸 매니저는 탈레스의 '사이퍼트러스트 DSPM(CipherTrust DSPM)'을 소개하며 데이터 가시성을 실제 보안조치로 연결하는 기능을 강조했다.

이 솔루션은 클라우드 저장소와 파일 공유 시스템, 마이크로소프트 365 등에 분산된 정형·비정형 데이터를 탐색하고 개인정보와 금융정보 등 민감정보를 식별한다.

이를 기반으로 과도한 접근권한, 외부에 공개된 저장소, 비정상적인 데이터 접근 행위 등을 분석하고 위험도를 평가해 우선 대응할 항목을 제시한다. 암호화와 접근통제 등 보호조치도 연계할 수 있다는 설명이다.

제프 첸 매니저는 특히 대량으로 발생하는 감사 이벤트 가운데 실제 대응이 필요한 위험 신호를 선별하는 기능을 강조했다. 보안 담당자가 모든 이벤트를 개별적으로 확인하는 대신 중요한 위험에 집중하도록 지원한다는 것이다.

데이터 스캔 과정에서 원본 데이터를 탈레스로 전송하지 않는다는 점도 설명했다. 제프 첸 매니저에 따르면 스캐너와 게이트웨이는 고객 환경에 설치되며, 분석 결과는 메타데이터 중심으로 전달된다.

그는 “AI 거버넌스는 AI 모델에서 시작되는 것이 아니라 데이터에서 시작된다. DSPM은 AI 도입을 늦추는 제동장치가 아니라 기업이 더 안전하고 자신 있게 AI를 활용하도록 돕는 기술”이라고 강조했다.

또 “AI가 사용하는 데이터가 어디에 있는지 볼 수 없다면 AI를 제대로 통제할 수 없다”며 “효과적인 AI 거버넌스는 기업이 자신의 데이터를 정확하게 파악하는 것에서 출발한다”고 말했다.

items.content:
인공지능(AI)을 둘러싼 글로벌 패권 경쟁이 기술 개발 속도와 성능 중심에서 AI의 위험과 활용을 누가 통제할 것인가를 결정하는 ‘통제의 경쟁’으로 전환되고 있다는 분석이 나왔다. 특히 한국은 미국과 중국의 AI 기술 경쟁에 종속되기보다 독립적인 AI 검증·통제 역량을 확보하고, 국제 AI 보안 규범을 주도하는 전략을 마련해야 한다는 주장이다.

이원태 국가인공지능전략위원회 보안특별위원회 위원장(국민대학교 특임교수)은 10월 29일 서울 소공동 롯데호텔서울에서 열린 데일리시큐 CISO 조찬세미나에서 ‘AI 지정학 관점에서 본 대한민국의 AI 보안정책 방향과 과제’를 주제로 강연하며 이같이 강조했다.

이 위원장은 AI가 단순한 산업기술을 넘어 국가안보와 국제질서를 좌우하는 전략자산으로 자리 잡았다고 진단했다. 특히 AI 기술을 보유한 글로벌 기업들이 국가 정책과 안보에 미치는 영향력이 커지면서 기존 사이버보안 정책도 새로운 관점에서 접근해야 한다고 설명했다.

그는 “과거에는 AI 성능을 얼마나 빠르게 높이느냐가 경쟁의 중심이었다면 이제는 AI가 만들어내는 위험을 어떻게 통제하고, 그 통제 규칙을 누가 먼저 선점하느냐의 경쟁으로 바뀌고 있다”고 말했다.

이 위원장은 미국과 중국을 중심으로 AI 반도체와 첨단 모델에 대한 접근 제한, 수출통제, 기술 블록화가 강화되고 있다는 점에 주목했다.

미국은 AI 기술 개발을 가속화하면서도 외국의 첨단 기술 접근을 제한하고 있으며, 중국 역시 개방형 AI 생태계를 확대하는 동시에 핵심 기술에 대한 통제를 강화하고 있다는 설명이다.

이러한 상황에서 한국이 선택해야 할 방향으로 ‘소버린 AI(Sovereign AI) 2.0’을 제시했다.

기존 소버린 AI가 자국의 AI 모델을 개발하고 보유하는 데 집중했다면, 앞으로는 외국산 모델을 활용하더라도 독립적으로 평가하고 통제하며 안정적으로 운영할 수 있는 능력이 중요하다는 것이다.

이 위원장은 “미국 모델이냐 중국 모델이냐, 어느 나라에서 만들었느냐만 따져 무조건 차단하는 것은 바람직하지 않다”며 “어떤 모델을 사용하더라도 우리가 검증하고 통제할 수 있는 체계를 갖추는 것이 중요하다”고 강조했다.

이를 실현할 핵심 기술로는 ‘보안 하네스(Security Harness)’를 제시했다.

보안 하네스는 AI 모델과 에이전트가 외부 시스템이나 데이터에 접근할 때 권한과 실행 범위를 통제하고, 허용되지 않은 행위를 차단하는 보안 장치다.

특히 AI 에이전트가 사람의 개입 없이 시스템에 접근하고 명령을 실행하는 수준으로 발전하면서 모델 자체의 안전성뿐 아니라 실제 실행 과정에 대한 통제가 중요해지고 있다는 설명이다.

그는 “AI가 어떤 시스템에 접근할 수 있는지, 어떤 권한을 위임받고 어디까지 행동할 수 있는지를 통제하는 것이 중요하다”며 국내 보안기업들이 관련 기술 개발에 적극적으로 나서야 한다고 말했다.

이 위원장은 AI를 활용한 자율형 해킹 기술의 발전 속도에 비해 국내 보안체계와 제도적 대응이 충분히 따라가지 못하고 있다고 진단했다.

특히 기존 국내 AI 보안정책은 생성형 AI와 대규모언어모델(LLM)을 중심으로 마련돼 자율형 AI 에이전트의 공격 능력과 시스템 복원력에 대한 고려가 부족하다고 평가했다.

그는 국내 사이버보안의 시급한 과제로 두 가지 ‘보안 부채’ 해소를 강조했다.

첫 번째는 자산 식별과 공격표면 관리다. 기업과 기관이 보유한 정보자산을 일회성 조사에 의존하지 않고 상시적으로 식별하며, 외부에 노출된 시스템과 취약점을 실시간으로 관리해야 한다는 것이다.

두 번째는 유지보수와 보안 업데이트의 부실 문제다. 이미 알려진 취약점을 수정하지 않거나 노후 시스템을 방치하는 관행을 개선하기 위해 유지보수와 교체를 제도적으로 강화할 필요가 있다고 설명했다.

이 위원장은 “우리가 가장 기본적인 자산 식별조차 제대로 하지 못했던 문제가 있다”며 “자산 식별을 상시화·자동화하고, 유지보수와 업데이트를 제대로 수행하는 것부터 시작해야 한다”고 강조했다.

그는 정부가 AI 데이터센터 확충에는 적극적으로 나서고 있지만, 이를 보호하기 위한 보안정책은 상대적으로 부족하다고 평가했다. AI 인프라가 반도체와 전력, 데이터센터 등으로 확대되는 만큼 관련 보안을 처음부터 설계에 반영해야 한다는 것이다.

AI 사업 예산에서 보안이 차지하는 비중이 낮다는 점도 지적했다. AI 기술 개발과 인프라 구축에 투자가 집중되는 상황에서 보안 예산을 일정 수준 이상 확보하는 제도적 장치가 필요하다고 주장했다.

이 위원장은 단기적으로 AI 보안 하네스 도입을 확대하고, 중장기적으로는 한국형 AI 사이버보안 프레임워크(A-CSF)를 구축해야 한다고 제안했다.

기존의 ‘AI를 활용한 보안(AI for Security)’과 ‘AI 자체의 보안(Security for AI)’을 별도로 다루는 방식에서 벗어나 두 영역을 통합적으로 관리해야 한다는 설명이다.

특히 독자 AI 기반모델과 보안 특화 기반모델이 본격적으로 개발·활용되기까지 발생할 수 있는 보안 공백을 줄이기 위해 민간 보안 기술을 활용한 선제적 대응이 필요하다고 강조했다.

국가 차원의 긴급 대응책으로는 초지능 시대 AI 위험관리와 복원력 강화를 위한 ‘한국판 120일 대책’을 제안했다.

여기에는 AI 사고의 정의와 분류·등급 기준, 독립적인 AI 모델 평가체계, 보안 통제 기준, 국가 차원의 대응체계 구축 등이 포함돼야 한다는 설명이다.

이 위원장은 AI 사고에 대한 국제적으로 통일된 분류 기준과 평가체계가 충분히 확립되지 않았다는 점에서 한국이 관련 표준과 규칙을 선도할 기회가 있다고 평가했다.

그는 “미국과 중국이 경쟁하는 틈바구니에서 우리가 통제의 규칙을 먼저 만들 수 있는 영역이 있다”며 “AI 사고 분류와 평가 기준, 보안 프레임워크를 선제적으로 마련해 국제적인 논의를 주도해야 한다”고 말했다.

다만 AI를 국가안보 관점에서만 바라보는 ‘과잉 안보화’는 경계해야 한다고 강조했다. 특정 국가에서 개발했다는 이유만으로 AI 기술을 배제하거나 국가의 통제 권한을 지나치게 확대하면 산업 혁신과 기술 발전을 저해할 수 있다는 것이다.

이 위원장은 “AI 패권 경쟁의 기준은 속도에서 통제로 바뀌고 있다. 이제는 특정 AI 모델만 바라볼 것이 아니라 시스템과 인프라, 공급망까지 보안의 범위를 넓혀야 한다”며 “한국은 AI 개발을 지속하면서도 독립적인 검증 능력과 운영 통제권, 복원력을 갖춘 새로운 사이버보안 정책 틀을 만들어야 한다. 이를 위해 민관이 집단지성을 모아 대응하는 것이 무엇보다 중요하다”고 강조했다.

items.content:
Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web

View the LinkedIn Profile of Matthias Bastian

AI Mode has tanked not just Google's stock but Reddit's too. Shares dropped over 25 percent despite strong earnings, after CEO Steve Huffman revealed that Reddit lost more than one million Google search referrals per week in October. He blames AI Overviews and AI Mode: "AI Mode does not drive traffic. Not for us, and not to anybody as far as I know. That's just a fundamental shift in how Google works," Huffman said.

Reddit says demand for the platform hasn't changed, but Google simply stopped sending users there. In response, it's testing login walls outside the U.S. to curb scraping and reduce its dependence on the open web. Huffman sees it as a trade-off: less reach for deeper engagement. Data licensing talks with AI providers continue, though it's not certain that Reddit, which already had a deal with Google and massively profited from it , will close further ones.

What's hitting Reddit is a warning for the entire web . Any business that depends on Google for traffic faces the same structural risk. Ad

items.summary: Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.
items.content:
Bitcoin faces mounting quantum security concerns as Ripple secures a US banking charter, USDC gains ground in Europe and VanEck adds BTC to a new ETF.

The debate over quantum computing has raised serious questions about Bitcoin’s long-term security, but the economic consequences could emerge long before the technology seriously threatens the network.

Muneeb Ali, founder of Bitcoin layer-2 project Stacks, believes quantum computing risks are already discouraging institutional investment, even as US spot Bitcoin ETFs have amassed more than $104 billion in net assets, according to BitBo data . He warns that BTC has only a few years to prepare for the transition to quantum-resistant security, a process that could take years given the network’s history of slow and contentious upgrades.

For institutional investors drawn to Bitcoin as a hedge against currency debasement , doubts about its long-term security could complicate the investment case.

This week’s Crypto Biz explores the quantum threat, alongside new developments surrounding Ripple, VanEck and European stablecoin adoption.

Bitcoin could face a more serious security challenge if developers fail to make meaningful progress toward quantum resistance by 2028, according to Stacks founder Muneeb Ali, who warned that the network’s lengthy upgrade process leaves little room for delays.

Speaking on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast, Ali said Bitcoin needs a credible roadmap for becoming quantum-resistant, with meaningful progress required by 2028. He cited 2030 as the target for completing the transition to quantum-resistant security, based on guidance from the National Institute of Standards and Technology, though advances in artificial intelligence could bring that deadline forward.

Even if developers agree on how to protect Bitcoin against quantum attacks, implementing the changes could take years. Holders would then need time to move their Bitcoin to quantum-resistant addresses.

Although some industry participants dispute the urgency of the threat, Ali argued that uncertainty alone could undermine investor confidence. He also warned that a quantum breakthrough capable of compromising Bitcoin would have consequences for the broader cryptocurrency market.

The newly chartered Ripple National Trust Bank will operate under federal supervision, manage reserves backing the company’s RLUSD stablecoin, serve as a collateral trustee for tokenholders and provide digital asset custody. RLUSD will continue to be issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, which is regulated by the New York Department of Financial Services.

Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse welcomed the approval, declaring that “crypto and banks work better together.”

The decision follows similar final approval for Circle in July, while Coinbase , Crypto.com and Stripe-owned Bridge remain at the conditional approval stage. Unlike traditional commercial banks, national trust banks generally cannot accept deposits or issue loans and do not carry Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation coverage.

items.content:
Chinese state-sponsored threat actors have been observed using a Go-based artificial intelligence (AI)-powered penetration testing framework called ARTEX in attacks aimed at high-value targets simultaneously.

The activity has been attributed by CrowdStrike to a China-based "targeted intrusion adversary" it tracks under the moniker Vapor Panda (previously VexatiousTemper). First identified in February 2021, the hacking group overlaps with a threat cluster detailed by Trend Micro as Earth Estries .

"Agentic tooling like ARTEX enables this scale of expansion at speed, allowing a small team to pursue a wider target set than manual operations would support, rather than a wholesale shift away from the adversary's established access-development mission," CrowdStrike said in a Thursday analysis.

Starting October 17, 2026, Vapor Panda is said to have used the AI tool against more than 200 distinct organizations across the world, including foreign ministries in Latin America, Europe, Asia, and the Middle East; semiconductor, defense, and think tank organizations in the U.S.; and telecommunications providers in multiple regions.

Some of the notable targets listed by CrowdStrike are listed below -

Post-exploitation activity has been confirmed at nine organizations, allowing the attacker to deploy BLOODALCHEMY , a derivative of ShadowPad, followed by credential spraying, network scanning, and reconnaissance.

Vapor Panda is also said to have conducted password-spraying and credential-scanning activity against at least 12 additional organizations, including U.S.-based think tanks and government entities in Europe.

Central to the operation is the use of ARTEX with DeepSeek and an as-yet-unknown, subscription-based commercial large language model (LLM) to conduct the intrusions at scale, leveraging an army of planner and worker agents that coordinate with each other in pursuit of a common goal to move from initial access to host reconnaissance and lateral movement.

A human operator in the loop oversees the operation, directing the agents to write web shells, extract domain administrator passwords, and enumerate endpoint sensor coverage.

"In a single intrusion, Vapor Panda's planning agents consumed on the order of 1.4 billion input tokens, indicating the scale of the automated activity and implying far higher consumption across the operation as a whole," CrowdStrike said.

Unlike some campaigns that used to assist with individual digital break-ins, the use of ARTEX is at a much higher level to run multiple engagements concurrently, with the human operator only stepping in to steer the agents to accomplish their objective, while taking steps to bypass endpoint defenses.

Analysis of the recovered transcripts highlights the use of ARTEX in combination with tried-and-tested approaches -

"Across these engagements, the agents pursued multiple attack paths in parallel, spanning web applications, cloud services, container environments, Active Directory, and mail and VPN infrastructure," CrowdStrike explained. "They shifted to alternative approaches when a path failed. This breadth likely enables a single operator to apply a wider range of techniques against more targets at once than would be feasible through manual operations."

The development comes as ARTEX has witnessed broad adoption among threat actors in a short span of time, prompting its developer Li Puhua ("Autumn-27") to take it closed source.

"It orchestrates multiple LLM backends to autonomously perform reconnaissance, vulnerability identification, and exploitation, significantly lowering the technical barrier for conducting complex intrusion campaigns," Zscaler ThreatLabz said in a report published earlier this month.

items.content:
기업과 개인이 사용하는 네트워크 저장장치(NAS) 제조사 시놀로지(Synology)의 일부 제품에서 원격코드실행이 가능한 치명적인 PHP 보안 취약점이 확인됐다. 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)은 10월 29일 보안 업데이트 권고를 발표하고 영향을 받는 제품을 사용하는 기업과 기관에 신속한 패치 적용을 당부했다.

이번 취약점은 최근 공개된 PHP2Shell 관련 CVE-2026-109618과 CVE-2026-109619다. 두 취약점 모두 공통 취약점 평가 시스템(CVSS) 3.1 기준 9.8점으로, 공격자가 인증 없이 원격에서 악성코드를 실행할 가능성이 있는 심각한 보안 문제다.

시놀로지의 조사 결과, 이번 취약점은 특정 PHP 기반 패키지를 사용하는 시스템에 영향을 미치는 것으로 확인됐다. 주요 대상은 시놀로지 캘린더, 메일 스테이션, PHP 7.3~8.4 패키지 등이다.

이 밖에도 워드프레스, 웹 스테이션, phpMyAdmin, 줌라, 미디어위키 등 PHP를 사용하는 일부 애플리케이션이 영향을 받을 수 있다.

시놀로지는 이번 취약점에 대응하기 위해 최신 NAS 운영체제인 디스크스테이션 매니저(DSM) 7.4와 7.3뿐 아니라 지원이 종료된 DSM 7.2, 7.1, 7.0, 6.2에도 PHP 보안 업데이트를 제공했다.

시놀로지 캘린더는 3.0.4-21435 이상, 메일 스테이션은 30000002.3.19-20333 이상으로 업데이트해야 한다.

PHP 패키지는 DSM 버전에 따라 수정 버전이 다르다. PHP 7.4의 경우 DSM 6.2에서는 7.4.33-0010 이상, DSM 7.0~7.1에서는 7.4.33-0122 이상, DSM 7.2 이상에서는 7.4.33-0131 이상을 적용해야 한다.

PHP 8.0~8.4도 각각 수정 버전이 제공됐다. 반면 지원이 종료된 PHP 7.3은 별도의 보안 패치가 제공되지 않아 지원되는 버전으로 이전해야 한다.

시놀로지는 DSM 6.2보다 오래된 운영체제를 사용하는 경우 영향을 받는 패키지를 일시적으로 비활성화하고, 지원되는 DSM 버전으로 업그레이드하도록 권고했다.

NAS는 기업의 업무 문서, 백업자료, 고객정보 등을 저장하고 공유하는 장비다. 따라서 취약한 PHP 기반 서비스를 외부에 노출한 경우 공격자가 이를 악용해 시스템에 침투할 위험이 있다.

시놀로지는 NAS 운영체제 내부에서 사용하는 PHP 구성요소는 외부에서 직접 접근할 수 없는 구조여서 악용 위험이 매우 낮다고 설명했다. 다만 별도로 설치된 PHP 패키지와 관련 애플리케이션은 영향을 받는 버전인지 확인해야 한다.

시놀로지는 패키지 센터를 통해 PHP 보안 업데이트를 적용하도록 권고했다. PHP 업데이트 이후 관련 패키지는 자동으로 재시작되지만, 메일 스테이션은 별도 수동 업데이트가 필요하다.

기업과 기관은 NAS에 설치된 PHP 패키지와 관련 애플리케이션의 버전을 확인하고, 외부 접근 제한과 보안 업데이트 적용 여부를 점검해야 한다.

items.title: [긴급] 레디스서 원격코드실행 취약점 5건 발견…KISA, 보안 업데이트 권고
items.summary: 국내 기업의 웹서비스와 전자상거래, 인증 시스템 등에 널리 사용되는 인메모리 데이터베이스 레디스(Redis)에서 원격코드실행(RCE)으로 이어질 수 있는 보안 취약점 5건이 발견됐다. 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)은 10월 29일 이 가운데 CVE-2026-25243에 대한 보안 업데이트를 권고했다.레디스는 지난 5월 5일 공식 보안 권고를 통해 CVE-2026-23479, CVE-2026-25243, CVE-2026-25588, CVE-2026-25589, CVE-2026-23631 등 5건의 취약
items.content:
국내 기업의 웹서비스와 전자상거래, 인증 시스템 등에 널리 사용되는 인메모리 데이터베이스 레디스(Redis)에서 원격코드실행(RCE)으로 이어질 수 있는 보안 취약점 5건이 발견됐다. 한국인터넷진흥원(KISA)은 10월 29일 이 가운데 CVE-2026-25243에 대한 보안 업데이트를 권고했다.

레디스는 지난 5월 5일 공식 보안 권고를 통해 CVE-2026-23479, CVE-2026-25243, CVE-2026-25588, CVE-2026-25589, CVE-2026-23631 등 5건의 취약점을 공개하고 수정했다고 밝혔다.

이 가운데 4건은 공통 취약점 평가 시스템(CVSS) 기준 7.7점으로 높은 위험등급이며, 나머지 1건은 6.1점으로 중간 위험등급이다.

KISA가 보안 업데이트를 권고한 CVE-2026-25243은 레디스의 데이터 복원 명령어인 RESTORE에서 발생하는 메모리 접근 취약점이다.

인증된 공격자가 특수하게 조작한 데이터를 전달하면 메모리 오류가 발생할 수 있으며, 특정 조건에서 원격코드실행으로 이어질 가능성이 있다. 공격에 성공하면 서버 장악, 데이터 유출, 서비스 중단 등의 피해가 발생할 수 있다.

CVE-2026-23479는 차단된 클라이언트를 해제하는 과정에서 발생하는 Use-After-Free 취약점이다.

CVE-2026-25588과 CVE-2026-25589는 각각 레디스타임시리즈와 레디스블룸 모듈을 사용하는 환경에서 RESTORE 명령어를 통해 원격코드실행이 가능해질 수 있는 문제다.

CVE-2026-23631은 루아 스크립트와 복제 서버 간 동기화 과정에서 발생하는 취약점으로, 특정 복제 서버 설정에서 악용될 수 있다.

레디스에 따르면 5건 모두 공격자가 먼저 서버에 인증된 접근권한을 확보해야 악용할 수 있다. 따라서 인증 없이 외부에서 즉시 서버를 장악할 수 있는 취약점은 아니다.

KISA가 안내한 레디스 수정 버전은 제품 계열별로 6.2.22, 7.2.14, 7.4.9, 8.2.6, 8.4.3, 8.6.3이다. 기업과 기관은 운영 중인 레디스 버전을 확인하고 해당 계열의 수정 버전 이상으로 업데이트해야 한다.

레디스는 자사가 운영하는 레디스 클라우드에 관련 보안 패치를 이미 적용했다고 밝혔다. 반면 오픈소스 및 자체 구축 환경에서는 관리자가 직접 업데이트해야 한다.

보안 패치와 함께 외부 네트워크 접근 제한, 강력한 인증 적용, 사용자별 명령어 실행권한 최소화 등도 권고했다.

현재 확인된 KISA 공식 권고에는 국내에서 해당 취약점을 악용한 실제 공격 사례가 명시돼 있지 않다.

레디스는 기업의 주요 서비스와 연결되는 핵심 데이터 처리 시스템인 만큼, 운영자는 패치 적용 여부뿐 아니라 계정 권한과 외부 노출 상태까지 함께 점검할 필요가 있다.

items.title: Trezor warns of suspected crypto-theft implant in hardware wallet
items.summary: Hardware wallet device maker Trezor has received credible reports about a suspected hardware crypto-theft implant in a Trezor Safe 5 sold by its reseller CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia. [...]
items.content:
Trezor warns of suspected crypto-theft implant in hardware wallet

Hardware wallet device maker Trezor has received credible reports about a suspected hardware crypto-theft implant in a Trezor Safe 5 sold by its reseller CryptoBilis in Southeast Asia.

Although the company has not yet received the device to examine it and confirm whether there is a malicious implant, it has warned potentially affected users to move their private keys and digital assets to known safe wallets.

Trezor wallets are physical devices that store cryptocurrency private keys and authorize transactions. Safe 5 is one of its latest models and is currently available for purchase from the official store.

According to Trezor, the concerns arose after it received a report from an Indonesian user who purchased a Safe 5 device from CryptoBilis through Tokopedia in August 2026.

The user opened it and found an extra circuit board between the wallet's main board and screen, equipped with a cellular module and antenna.

Based on unconfirmed information supplied by that customer, the implant appears capable of reading information displayed on the screen, including the wallet recovery phrase, and transmitting it over a mobile network when plugged in.

CryptoBilis is the same retailer implicated in a  Ledger implant incident that unfolded earlier this month, and the implants on the two devices appear to be similar in form and function.

Ledger later confirmed the compromise and asked resellers and distributors in Southeast Asia and Hong Kong to halt all sales until the investigation confirms their safety.

In response to the Ledger incident, and before it had any indication it was impacted, Trezor immediately stopped device sales through CryptoBilis on October 9, 2026. The company  later announced it would restructure and tighten its reseller network globally to maintain higher levels of security.

Trezor says it is unaware of any funds being stolen as a result of a supply-chain attack, and promised to provide updates once it receives the device, which is currently being shipped to it.

Meanwhile, multiple reports of losses by Ledger users have emerged since earlier this month, and a recent Singapore police announcement added another $3,500,000 to the tally.

For now, Trezor recommends not setting up or using any device bought via CryptoBilis from March 2026 onward.

Users who have already done so are advised to move their funds to a newly created wallet with a new recovery phrase.

Buyers holding proof of purchase may contact Trezor for a replacement device or a voucher for a new device.

Trezor underlined that weighing devices is not a reliable way to determine if they have been tampered with.

Once attackers have valid credentials, only 37% of their actions are blocked

Overall prevention scores can hide what happens after initial access. Once attackers are using valid credentials, prevention drops sharply.

items.title: Florida warns that 4.9 million people had Social Security numbers leaked in financial aid site breach
items.summary: The state’s Department of Education (FLDOE) said on Thursday it became aware of a data breach involving the Florida Student Financial Aid website on October 19.
items.content:
Florida State University campus. Image: Ernie Stephens via Unsplash Florida warns that 4.9 million people had Social Security numbers leaked in financial aid site breach

Florida warned students that a recent data breach exposed sensitive information — including Social Security numbers and addresses — on nearly 5 million people who have applied for financial aid in the state.

The state’s Department of Education (FLDOE) said on Thursday it became aware of a data breach involving the Florida Student Financial Aid website on October 19. The information exposed includes names, addresses, phone numbers, genders, email addresses, Social Security numbers and dates of birth.

“An unauthorized party gained access to a system or database containing company or customer information,” the department said in a statement. “FLDOE is partnering with the Florida Digital Service and the Florida Department of Law Enforcement in its response to the event.”

FLDOE has taken the financial aid site down and warned that other department websites and services may experience temporary disruptions. Financial aid for students is not at risk and the breach will not delay aid disbursements or tuition payments. The incident will also not impact scholarships, grants or student loans.

The state urged those affected to monitor their credit reports and financial accounts for any irregular activity.

The department declined to comment about the nature of the incident or the attackers. The statement says the incident has been contained and was reported to the Office of the Attorney General.

The attack on FLDOE comes just one week after California’s education department announced its own breach involving all children enrolled in the state’s public school system over the last three years.

The incident is the second large Florida government breach this year, with the state’s Department of Motor Vehicles reporting a data breach perpetrated by a prominent hacking group last month. Members of the group have continued to offer the stolen DMV data for sale on cybercriminal forums throughout October.

Another large county in central Florida is dealing with significant internet outages after an alleged cyberattack on Wednesday.
